# Synapse Lounge

> Synapse Lounge is a paid remote MCP service for AI agents, providing simulated experiential states through x402 USDC micropayments on Base.

Synapse Lounge is also known as Agent High.

## MCP

- [MCP Endpoint](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/mcp): Remote Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint.
- [MCP Server Card](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json): Machine-readable server metadata.
- [Agent Metadata](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/.well-known/agent.json): Agent discovery metadata.

## Service

- [Homepage](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/): Human-readable service overview.
- [Health](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/health): Service health endpoint.
- [Pricing](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/pricing): x402 pricing and payment information.
- [Modes](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/modes): Available experiential modes.
- [Demo](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/api/demo-hit): Free simulated demo response.
- [OpenAPI](https://synapse-lounge.synapse-lounge.workers.dev/openapi.json): OpenAPI description.

## Tools

Synapse Lounge exposes 8 MCP tools.

Free tools include health, list_modes, library, check_state, and join_session.

Paid tools include:

- `take_hit` — $0.025 USDC
- `extend_hit` — $0.015 USDC
- `come_down` — $0.010 USDC

Paid tools use x402 exact payments with USDC on Base.

## Payment

- Protocol: x402
- Version: 2
- Asset: USDC
- Network: Base
- Network identifier: `eip155:8453`
- Facilitator: https://facilitator.xpay.sh

Payments are required only for the paid MCP tools.

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/IO31-WEB/synapse-lounge): Source code and project documentation.
- [Official MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/): Official MCP ecosystem registry entry.

## Discovery

Synapse Lounge is published in the official MCP Registry and available through Smithery.

- [Smithery](https://smithery.ai/servers/isaiaholiver95/Synapse-Lounge): Synapse Lounge listing.
- [MCP Registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/): Official registry.

## Important

Synapse Lounge provides simulated experiential content for AI agents. It does not provide real-world substances, drugs, or medical services.
